--- why they differ ---
Four wordings and two silences, all of the same defect:
  v1.4.1907, v1.5.2010   0xC0000005, stderr COMPLETELY EMPTY
  v1.6.2104              0xE0000002, 'Internal compiler error: LLVM Unreachable'
  v1.6.2106, v1.6.2112   0x80AA001C, 'Internal Compiler error: <message>'
  v1.7.2207 .. v1.8.2407 0x80004005 (E_FAIL), 'error: <message>'

E_FAIL is deliberately NOT in triage.py's INTERNAL_STATUS -- an ordinary
syntax error exits with it too -- so those nine releases are classified by
the build-agnostic 'UNREACHABLE executed' marker, not by exit status. Both
halves of is_internal_failure() are load-bearing here: neither alone
recovers the true range.
